description: Change what a step says or when it goes: send only what changes. A new `position` moves it there and the other steps close up around it. Subject and bodies are Liquid templates (`{{ first_name }}`, `{{ contact["Company size"] }}`, `{% if company %}`) with spintax (`{Hi|Hello}`) after them. One that does not parse answers 400 `templateInvalid`, with `details` naming each part and its line and column. Nothing is saved. Words in double brackets ([[like this]]) are a template's blanks: a save that still holds one answers 400 `stepBlank`, naming it. To start from words that already exist (list_campaign_templates, or get_saved_reply), copy them in as `bodyText`, and send `bodyHtml: ""` too when the step already has a formatted part, since most mail apps show that part. On a running campaign, a change that adds to what it sends or to whom also needs the `send` permission, and makes the caller its approver. Through an API key an owner limited, the key's limits must cover the campaign, every mailbox it sends from and outreach, or it answers 403 with `details.scope` naming the limit. A change that only takes something out needs none of that.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

weight.description: The step's own share of a split with its variants, relative to theirs: 50 beside one variant at 50 is half the leads. Only matters once the step has variants.
